body.label: Target
body.html: Two adjacent empty spaces within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, create temporary supported steps that let willing creatures ignore difficult terrain in those spaces. They can bridge only a 1-unit gap and vanish after the duration.

surges.html: One willing creature may move 2 units along the steps immediately.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Golem
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Golem Full Manifestation (FM-1G). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
